title: Unsupported actions/checkout runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve checkout depth, credentials, submodule, and sparse-checkout behavior configured through action inputs.

steps.title: Upgrade the checkout action
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to actions/checkout@v5 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review checkout inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options.
